title: Error Item
wikitext: {{Infobox |eng = Error Item |source = |season = All |sellprice = 0 |quality = false }} An '''Error Item''' is any item whose internal ID doesn't exist in [[Modding:Items|the game's item data]]. Error items have no associated item data and thus default to purchase/sell prices of {{Price|0}}, descriptions reading "''???''", and a placeholder 🛇 sprite. There are no known ways to produce an Error Item in the latest versions of the base game. However, they can occur due to mods. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |hate=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Haley }} ==Bundles== It is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Quests== It is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trivia== *{{version|1.0|Version 1.0}} of the game did not allow the player to enter brackets {{key|[ ]}}, so generating Error Items was not possible. ==History== {{History|1.2.26|You can no longer find an Error Item with a bread sprite in [[The Stardrop Saloon|The Saloon]]'s shop and the [[Garbage Can|garbage can]] outside the Saloon.}} {{History|1.5|The [[Secrets#Item Spawn Cheat|item spawn cheat]] now ignores invalid item IDs, instead of producing Error Items.}} {{History|1.6|2=Error items now display a placeholder 🛇 sprite, instead of whatever sprite matches their index position in the spritesheet.
